Smart Reads of the Week: Bonus Dividends, Singapore AI Stocks, and Passive Income Ideas
article:
Many investors spend their time worrying about the next market crash. Yet history has shown that long-term wealth is built not by predicting downturns, but by owning quality businesses that continue rewarding shareholders through every market cycle.
This week’s Smart Reads highlights blue-chip companies paying bonus dividends, Singapore businesses benefiting from the AI revolution, and REITs that could help investors build a dependable stream of passive income.
We also look at dividend stocks that can strengthen your savings, explore whether underperforming blue chips deserve a second chance, and discuss how to build a portfolio designed to compound wealth over the long run.
Here are this week’s top articles:
3 SGX Blue-Chip Rewarding Investors with Bonus Dividends

Hold or Sell? 3 Blue-Chip Stocks That Lagged the STI by 20% or More for 1H 2026
